title: Symbolic recurrence clears the representation wall but not the frontier
summary: Exact MDD local maps recover the Rule-5 closure as the stronger identity G^3=G and evaluate all 170 Research034 frontier questions without censoring. None has temporal recurrence or translated recurrence through horizon 6, so the missing exact reachability certificate must allow a different source provenance rather than merely recognizing ordinary temporal periodicity.
takeaway: The graph-presentation wall can be cleared symbolically, but compact local dynamics is not yet compact reachability: exact closure now needs a relational proof object that can re-present an output from a different source history.

promotion.idea: Exact reachability can require changing provenance
